content.name: Abandoned Ships Cleanup
content.description:
Abandoned ships never go away in X4. Every pilot that bails leaves a hull floating in space forever, so a long-running game accumulates them without limit - well over a thousand is normal, most of them combat leftovers, and many of them cluttering the map.
This mod puts an expiry clock on abandoned ships and destroys them when it runs out. The ships that are supposed to be there are left alone.
[h2]Settings[/h2] [list] [*][b]Ship lifetime[/b] - 5 to 300 minutes in steps of 5, default 5 hours. The game time an abandoned ship survives once the mod has seen it. Game time, so SETA speeds it up. [*][b]Debug logging[/b] - off by default. Logs every pass and every destruction. [/list] Changes apply from the next scan, with no reload.
[h2]Where to change them[/h2] With SirNukes Mod Support APIs installed: [b]Options - Extension Options - Abandoned Ships Cleanup[/b]. Settings are stored in the savegame, so each save carries its own.
Without that API the mod behaves exactly the same, configured from the constants at the top of md/drjele_abandoned_ships_cleanup.xml instead: $Lifetime (5h), $ScanInterval (5min), $GameStartGrace (60s), $StaleGap (15min), $BatchSize (100) and $DebugChance (0). They are re-read on every savegame load, so editing one and reloading is enough - no new game is needed. Any other mod or cheat menu can also override the two main ones at runtime through the globals $DrJeleAbandonedShipLifetime and $DrJeleAbandonedShipDebugChance.
[h2]What it never touches[/h2] The clock is only ever started on a ship that passes every one of these: [list] [*]In the main galaxy only. Every Timelines scenario, the Timelines hub, tutorials, the demo universe and the workshop map are left alone entirely. [*]Not on the game's own do-not-touch list: the nine abandoned ships Timelines places in the main galaxy, and every story or mission derelict from the base game, Split, Terran, Boron and Pirate. [*]Not placed at game start. Anything spawned during universe generation is spared, which covers the six vanilla claimable ships and every DLC static placement, present or future. [*]Not a wreck, so Tides of Avarice salvage is safe. [*]Not mission-spawned and not renamed - scripted content, and anything you gave a name to. [*]No inbound boarding operation and no salvage claim: ships you have already sent marines or a tug to. [*]Not invulnerable, not a drone, not a spacesuit, not docked, not highway traffic. [/list] Destruction is also held off while the ship is visible to you, so nothing ever pops out of existence in front of you. It is simply retried on the next pass.
[h2]Dependencies[/h2] [list] [*][b]X4: Foundations 9.00[/b] - required. [*][b]SirNukes Mod Support APIs[/b] - optional, and only for the in-game options menu. Everything works without it. [*]No DLC required. [/list]
[h2]Notes[/h2] Works on an existing savegame. Removing it takes the script and all of its per-ship bookkeeping with it; the only trace left in the save is the pair of inert global variables the options menu writes.
One galaxy scan every 5 minutes, walked 100 ships at a time on a 1-second tick, so a thousand derelicts never cost a whole frame. Each ship carries its own clock in two variables on the object itself - no per-ship cues, no global bookkeeping.
Source and full documentation: https://github.com/drjele/x4-abandoned-ships-cleanup

text.name: Abandoned Ships Cleanup
text.description: Puts an expiry timer on abandoned (ownerless) ships and destroys them when it runs out, sparing the ships placed at game start, story and mission derelicts, wrecks and anything currently being boarded or salvaged.
